import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric, handling commas and out-of-range values
    df = df.copy()
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Filter out-of-range body_mass_g (2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    # Fix flipper_length_mm negative value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170]
    # Clean island column: remove extra spaces
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Drop exact duplicates (if any)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    # Return as dict with keys as sex labels
    return result
